findings.summary: RTL: '#' is bidi class ET; between Urdu (R) and a Latin run it resolves to the RTL embedding (UBA W6→ON, N2→R), so '#general' is expected to display as 'general#' in a dir=rtl paragraph. Derived from the UBA, not rendered. The style guide forbids manual bidi controls in catalogues, so the fix is in the renderer (wrap the channel name in <bdi dir="ltr"> / isolateLtr via a {channel} placeholder). Same class as the previously-audited archive '#{name}' titles.
findings.disposition: deferred — renderer-side isolation, outside catalogue scope; recorded for the implementer/designer rendered RTL check
